summary.headline: Dermatology network secures $1.18M in annual savings across 12 spend categories
summary.narrative: Treya Partners helped Adult & Pediatric Dermatology (APDerm) unlock $1,179,965 in recurring annual savings by competitively sourcing and renegotiating 12 indirect spend categories. Six categories—Medical Supplies, Courier Services, Janitorial Services, Telecom Circuits, Office Supplies, and Small Parcel—are fully contracted and producing value, while the remaining six are in final negotiation or implementation. The program consolidated suppliers, leveraged GPO contracts and incumbent negotiations, and retained service continuity with minimal operational disruption.

impact.operational_improvements: Centralized purchasing across 30+ locations, standardized supplier contracts, and locked 12-24-month price guarantees while retaining incumbent partners to avoid service disruption.

proof_points.statement: Reduced Athenahealth revenue-share fee from 1.80% to 1.50%, generating $259,800 in annual savings (17%).
Negotiated 27% reduction on $1.8M Medical Supplies spend by moving to McKesson under HPG/Premier GPO—worth $485K annually.
Consolidated janitorial spend and locked new hourly rates delivering $193K annual savings with Enterprise Cleaning.
